nodes.name: PBA/MoO4/rGO Hydrothermal Synthesis
nodes.procedure: 0.6 mmol of Co(NO3)2 and 0.9 mmol of sodium citrate were firstly dispersed in 20 mL of GO DIW suspension (2 mg cm-1) under magnetic stirring. Then, 20 mL of K3Co(CN)6 aqueous solution (about 0.02 mmol mL-1) was added into the dispersion under magnetic stirring for 15 min. Subsequently, a certain amount molybdate ammonium (MA) (20, 30 and 40 mg) was added and stirred for 0.5 h in beaker. Then the homogeneous solution was transferred into a 50 mL Teflon-lined autoclave, which was sealed and maintained at 120°C for 12 h. The obtained PBA/MoO4/rGO precipitate was washed with DIW, and processed by freeze drying to collect precursor.

nodes.name: Phosphating Treatment
nodes.procedure: To prepare a-Co(PO3)2/MoO4/rGO, 50 mg of the resulting precursor and 1 g of NaH2PO2 were placed in two different positions of the porcelain boat, with NaH2PO2 on the upstream side. The system subsequently experienced 2 h of thermal treatment in Ar atmosphere of 400°C with a heating rate of 2°C min-1.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM images show cubic structure retained after phosphidation with rough and sunken surface for a-Co(PO₃)₂/MoO₄/rGO.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The SEM images of as-prepared samples after phosphidation are shown in Figure S1d and S3a, b. It can be found that the cubic structure and size are well retained after phosphidation, but the surface of cubes becomes rough and sunken due to the decomposition and shrinkage.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM images show cube structure with 2D rGO sheets for a-Co(PO₃)₂/MoO₄/rGO.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the 2D rGO sheets and cubes structure can be clearly observed from the TEM images of a- Co ( P O _ { 3 } ) _ { 2 } / r G O and a- C 0 ( P O _ { 3 } ) _ { 2 } / MoO _ { 4 } / r G O (Figure S4c, d and Fig. 1b, c).

nodes.characterization_summary: SAED image shows no obvious diffraction rings, indicating amorphous structure of a-Co(PO₃)₂/MoO₄/rGO.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the corresponding SAED image of a-Co ( P O _ { 3 } ) _ { 2 } / MoO _ { 4 } / r G O is shown in Fig. 1d, in which no obvious diffraction rings can be found, indicating a- C O ( P O _ { 3 } ) _ { 2 } / M o O _ { 4 } / r G O present the amorphous structure.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM reveals amorphous structure of a-Co(PO₃)₂/MoO₄/rGO with absence of typical lattice fringes.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-resolution TEM (HRTEM) image (Fig. 1e) further reveals that as-prepared a- C 0 ( P O _ { 3 } ) _ { 2 } / MoO _ { 4 } / r G 0 is amorphous structure, evidenced by the absence of typical lattice fringes.
